coverageNote.note: Constellation Brands operates ~12 NA production facilities (US + Mexico) + a few in Italy / NZ. We audited 11 NA sites; the international count is small enough to call.

account.networkCountSource: Constellation Brands FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Business (fiscal year ended Feb 28, 2025): 12 US wineries + 4 US distilleries + 2 Mexican breweries (Nava, Obregon). https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000016918/000001691825000022/stz-20250228.htm
account.sampleRationale: The 10 audited NA distribution and production sites are the core sample of Constellation's ~18 current NA production and import-distribution facilities feeding the Corona and Modelo network.
account.dossierIntro: Constellation Brands runs the Corona and Modelo import network alongside its wine and spirits production. We audited 10 of ~18 NA facilities. Wilmer TX (Dallas I-45) has 64 dock doors. Jurupa Valley CA is 71 acres. 2 of 10 audited sites are rail-served. Mexican imports cross at Texas and California, then fan out to retail. YardFlow runs the cross-dock as a deterministic protocol regardless of which port the trailer crossed at.
surprisingFindings: The beer DCs are pure import-distribution. Mexican beer flows into Texas and California, then fans out.
Jurupa Valley CA is 71 acres of beverage cross-dock. Largest single-site beer DC on the West Coast.
Wilmer TX runs 64 docks. Dallas I-45 is the Mexican beer pipeline.

sites.name: Robert Mondavi Winery - Oakville CA
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster coordinate (38.434323, -122.400476, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, moved only
4 m) was placed precisely against the street address, but the address
interpolation landed in the To Kalon vineyard just SE of the actual built
campus. Satellite probing at zoom 16-21 located the real building complex

This is positively the Robert Mondavi Winery, the historic Napa Valley
estate winery in Oakville, anchored by the renowned To Kalon Vineyard, with
the iconic Cliff May Mission-style arch and bell tower. Web research confirms
the estate reopened to visitors on April 20, 2026 following a multi-year
transformation (PRNewswire / Constellation press releases). The estate sits on

fieldNotes.facilityId: Robert Mondavi Winery confirmed at 7801 St. Helena Highway, Oakville CA - the iconic Napa Valley estate winery (To Kalon Vineyard), reopened April 2026 after a multi-year transformation. The estate sits on the EAST side of CA-29 / St. Helena Highway. The roster coordinate (38.434323, -122.400476) landed in the To Kalon vineyard just SE of the building complex; the actual built campus center is ~38.4357, -122.4013.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance is an open landscaped driveway off CA-29 with a stone monument sign pier and visitor parking; no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point across the lane (Street View 2024-08). Open winery estate entrance - marked false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the entrance. Only a landscaped monument sign and the visitor parking lot.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate identified, so remoteGs is false.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach: the entrance driveway runs only a short distance from CA-29 into the front parking/courtyard area before reaching the buildings - holds at most 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Trucks and visitors enter and exit through the same single driveway off CA-29.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estate winery, not a freight DC. No long bank of freight dock doors. A small service/loading area on the production-cellar building handles wine and grape movement; estimate ~3-7 service doors. Low confidence from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls holding bobtailed trailers; not a drop yard. dropArea NONE.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: No physically separate shipping and receiving dock clusters; a single service area on the production building. shipRcvSeparate false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Estate campus with multiple distinct buildings: the large red-roofed production/aging cellar, a visitor/hospitality building with the iconic Cliff May arch and courtyard, an outdoor stainless tank farm, a crush/processing structure, and ancillary estate buildings.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform identified in the truck path; marked false with low confidence (a harvest grape scale may exist near the crush pad but is not confirmed in imagery).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs alongside CA-29 on the property's west frontage, but no rail spur enters the winery property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Heart of Napa Valley wine country - the estate is surrounded by the To Kalon vineyard and other vineyards near the small unincorporated community of Oakville, well outside any dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural, but Oakville / central Napa Valley is well-developed wine country with normal cellular coverage; connectivityIssue false.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Roughly 2 trucks/trailers visible in the production service area in captured imagery; honest estimate - the site is a visitor estate, not a trailer-heavy yard.

fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the developed estate campus (buildings, tank farm, crush pad, parking, immediate landscaping) - ~14 acres. The broader To Kalon vineyard holding is far larger but is farmland, not yard.

fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access to the distillery is a long winding private mountain road from the base parking area up to the building cluster; ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Craft distillery. The NW face of the main distillery building has a covered/canopy loading apron with a few tanks and equipment; ~3-5 service/loading doors estimated. No large freight-dock bank. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls with parked trailers. Lots near the distillery are visitor/employee car parking.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: The distillery complex is several connected/adjacent red-roof structures (distillery, refectory/restaurant, general store). Treated as one campus; multipleFacilities left false as it is a single integrated complex. buildingCount ~3 distinct roof sections, marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Remote hillside in the mountains near Wanship/Park City, surrounded by open rangeland on the private Blue Sky Ranch; clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Isolated mountain location far from any town, on a large private ranch, cellular coverage likely weak. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Possible second checkpoint (ranch gatehouse, then distillery arrival) but no clear evidence of a separate dock-side checkpoint; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.

citations.claim: High West whiskey explicitly named in Constellation's retained Fine Wine & Craft Spirits portfolio
Official site gives current directions to the Wanship production distillery at Blue Sky Ranch, 27649 Old Lincoln Hwy (operating)

verification.rationale: Constellation owns High West (acquired 2016); retained June 2025; Wanship Blue Sky Ranch distillery currently operating with active tours/dining.
